entry.count_unit: One concrete temporary single-user storage scene. Controller/wormhole/remote/callback/message/codec and stock/matrix helpers merged, no split credit.
entry.full_chain_observation:
固定occultism2373141325d6bcfabf1a03b28eb647e19ab745ee，实际StorageControllerBlock/StableWormholeBlock/BE/menu factories与modbus注册调用已读；两种入口共享StorageControllerContainerBase的一套临时会话佔用实现。变种注册、颜色、材质与ID不拆数。

Base声明public static ConcurrentMap<BlockPos,UUID> openContainers；不是持久成员名单、道具所有权或玩家的永久授权。canOpen若位置未佔用或所存UUID等于当前player允许，已有不同UUID则发container_already_open译文key的RED systemmessage并false。

实际StorageControllerBlock.useItemOn服务端检查BlockEntity为MenuProvider→canOpen→ServerPlayer后才openMenu(provider,pos)，紧接reserve.put(pos,playerUUID)。openMenu的返回结果未检查，reserve是在调用之后，不是确认UI已打开的客户端回执。

StableWormholeBlock在本地wormhole位置应用同一canOpen，再查linkedcontroller存在才openMenu/reserve。linked块状态但controller未载入另发not_loaded key；它和主controller是同一会话佔用家族，而非两个引用。

两个block的useItemOn最终均返回SUCCESS，即使先前canOpen拒绝或没有真正open。拒绝结论来自真实canOpen false与明确消息producer，不从SUCCESS反推。

Base removed先updateCraftingSlots/updateOrderSlot，再super.removed，最后values.removeIf匹配playerUUID；释放不是按当前pos或containerid执行的精确compare/remove，而是全表删除该UUID值。没有finally，不能保证前序异常后仍清理。

映射key只有BlockPos；所读声明/put/get均不含dimension、server实例或会话epoch。canOpen的containsKey/get与reserve.put分离，ConcurrentMap并不把这些组合调用变成一次原子抢占；实际线程/事件顺序未执行，不声称竞态已发生。

完整StorageControllerContainer.stillValid先非null、当前level.getBlockEntity(pos)必须同一个controller对象，再每40worldtick发送stocks/machines，最后distanceSqr<=64。完整方法没有再检查openContainers的持有UUID。

完整StableWormholeContainer.stillValid检查wormhole与controller非null、本地wormhole身份相同、当前linked目标解析对象等于缓存controller，然后slow同步及到wormhole距离。不是到跨维controller距离；映射仍按本地入口pos，而非同一全局controller归一化。

Base removed由所有三个已读container子类继承，remote没有override。完整remote open两个producer没有直接canOpen/reserve，因此不能宣称同一库的所有入口均受这个map保护。被移除remote容器沿同一基类释放代码路径，但引擎是否/何时触发removed未扩展。

Remote实际useOn仅server把IStorageController位置写LINKED_STORAGE_CONTROLLER并发linked消息；GlobalBlockPos codec有dimension+pos，component声明persistent/networkSynchronized。只记录实际绑定，不把codec与旧storage/matrix读取拆新credit。

Remote ordinaryuse要linked且server，直接取targetworld，检查hasChunkAt；不loaded发not_loaded，目标IStorageController且ServerPlayer则openMenu。键盘MessageOpenStorageRemote是注册playToServer，空encode/decode，handler由ctx.player取得server/player，随后在服务端重选remote并看组件及targetblock。两条分支的null/chunk检查并不完全相同。

完整Curios选择方法优先当前selected item、再firstcurio、再firstinventoryremote。Item.createMenu会重新调用该selector；普通use缓冲写当前selectedslot，packet写selector.selectedSlot，故不宣称所有客户端/服务端实际选中目标在多remote/offhand场景必一致。

Remotecontainer固定非负selectedslot时重读该inventoryslot并要求StorageRemoteItem，slots的mayPlace/mayPickup均false、hasItemfalse；selected=-1则每次重查当前firstcurio。锁槽不是不可变stackUUID/组件版本令牌。

Remote stillValid通过当前remote重新解析controller，服务端40worldtick发stock/machine更新，最后要求controller非null与remote不是EMPTY；没有本地距离门或reservation检查。整条remote对照只作同一policy覆盖边界，不新计另一种membership gate。

BlockEntityUtil.get对空GlobalBlockPos返回null，同维要求isLoaded后取当前BE，client跨维拒绝，server跨维取当前server的level后相同加载检查；未读native getChunkAt/getBlockEntity实现，不能把直接packet查询推断为强制加载或实际崩溃。

矩阵/ORDER_STACK读写、controller资源索引、storage saveNetwork父桥、worker FIFO/注册与paid矿机/战场整体保留既有迁移/扫描owner。新候选不把remote矩阵编码、库存数量、queue或release副作用单独作为引用。

与119完整区域多站点any-denier及120完整owner全局仅收紧/撤权重查不同，本候选最多为一个“打开前的临时位置→当前使用玩家占用，冲突明确拒绝，关闭后按玩家释放，且入口覆盖不一致”的存储协作机制。单独Map、UUID、红字、callback或remote wrapper均0；由Main判断整项是否有独立语义。

Main finding: Concrete physical controller and wormhole entry checks a static ConcurrentMap<BlockPos,UUID> through canOpen. A foreign UUID produces RED container_already_open systemmessage and prevents this openMenu branch; same UUID remains admissible. This is one temporary occupancy control mechanism, not a permanent trusted-member authorization policy.

Main finding: canOpen performs separate contains/get and reserve performs put after openMenu with no actual successful-menu receipt. ConcurrentMap does not make that composite admission atomic. BlockPos alone omits dimension/server/session namespace; no runtime race or exploit is asserted.

Main finding: Controller and wormhole physical blocks return SUCCESS independently of denial. Wormhole reserves the local entrance position, not the linked controller position. Its missing loaded-controller message is a separate branch of this same scene, not another credit.

Main finding: Base removed first updates crafting/order state and calls super, then removes every map entry whose value equals this player UUID. It does not compare an exact menu token or position, does not use finally, and does not establish all native disconnect/death/level-change callback paths.

Main finding: Physical controller stillValid checks current BE object identity, loaded state/distance and a forty-worldtick refresh; wormhole checks current local BE plus resolved linked controller identity and local distance. Neither shown method rechecks or owns a distinct occupancy reservation.

Main finding: Ordinary remote use and the empty C2S remote-open consumer select an actual remote and open the storage menu without the same direct canOpen/reserve calls. Ordinary use includes hasChunkAt while message consumer does not; this difference is not treated as verified network bypass. Remote inherits UUID-wide base removal, which can clear physical occupancy belonging to the same UUID.

Main finding: Remote menu selected inventory index versus curio reselection and CuriosUtil selected-first/curio-first/inventory fallback are real identity boundaries. UI mayPlace/mayPickup locks do not create an immutable stack/session token. GlobalBlockPos carries dimension for remote references while occupancy map does not.

Main finding: Global reference helper only resolves loaded blocks, cross-dimension server lookup and immediate BE access as shown; registry/menu factories and ctx.player dispatch bind concrete consumers. Matrix/order codecs, components, message wrappers, block variants and helpers are support0 under their preserved old owners.

Main finding: Compared complete eight saved migration/sweep judgments, seven formal Occultism judgments, three full lease/fight judgments, current119 substantive owner and the already independently reviewed120 whole. Existing save/worker FIFO, fairy/guardian/effect/damage/eye feedback and queen/watcher/ritual families stay whole. Accepted unit is the distinct position-keyed temporary occupancy-refusal/release implementation including its remote coverage divergence; at most one, no per-branch/map/UUID/codec credit.
entry.concrete_observation: 本地controller/wormhole开菜单先查位置→玩家占用，不同UUID时明确RED冲突消息并拒绝进入；openMenu调用后写占用，base removed按玩家删除全表匹配项。物理菜单以实时块身份/距离验证，remote开菜单不直接走相同map且继承释放，形成一个有明确覆盖边界的临时存储协作场景，至多1待Main审，非永久权限/资源事务。
entry.application_to_boss_immune: 区分准入策略、实际动作返回值、占用记录和释放/拒绝反馈；会话身份与维度/目标身份要准确，不用泛型SUCCESS或发送请求证明最终接受。仅记录程序原则，不新增本项目Boss/UI或普通体质提示要求。

未检查native openMenu、ServerPlayer菜单替换、仍有效检查和removed在断线/死亡/换维/关服时的全部调用链。不能说所有退出都释放、所有失败都回滚或陈旧map不会保留。

complete_saved_three_additional_judgment.full_chain_observation:
Registered Underzealot goals capture a valid ground-near sacrifice and startRiding without checking returned success. Target selection/hurt-alert suppressed while carrying/leader carrying/praying. Actual carrying sync flag is updated from passenger presence in server tick after super.tick.
Complete ritual goal separates follower and carrier eligibility. Followers seek ring positions, pray near altar and increment shared-looking but per-entity synced worship time; carrier >200 worship ticks plus >=3 praying followers triggers passenger.triggerSacrificeIn(300), then consumes local cloudCooldown400 and publishes event62. Validity/altar/position/digging and stop logic differ from later victim countdown.
Native hurt calls super first; only true plus isVehicle plus random<.65 ejects passengers. It does not itself clear victim isBeingSacrificed/sacrificeTime or immediately set carrying false. Goal stop resets worship/praying/particle position, ejects and conditionally sets carrier cooldown100. No rollback callback to committed victim timer.
Actual Gloomoth tick decrements armed sacrificeTime on server regardless of still being a passenger, then attempts Watcher conversion below0. Carrier postSacrifice/cooldown/advancement requires current Underzealot vehicle, but conversion does not. Vesper tick additionally requires isPassenger, so dismount pauses its timer without clearing the armed flag; later any passenger relation resumes, and conversion still does not require an Underzealot vehicle. Both trigger methods simply arm and replace timer.
Client events61/62 create particles/cloud,77 requests chant. ClientProxy type5 reuses sound by integer entity id and isSameEntity/alive; queues only if absent from queued/ticking lists and canPlaySound. UnderzealotSound canPlay requires !silent/praying/worship<MAX; running tick checks alive/praying, updates position/volume/pitch and stops otherwise. It does not itself stop when worship crosses MAX or silent changes. Removal clears map entry; no sound-manager stop call in that removal helper.
Native render burrow gate can suppress body; model carrying/praying interpolation reshapes pose, and armFreedom suppresses ordinary swing while carrying. These are state cues, not damage rejection text or verified visual feedback. Buried targetability/push/pick filters differ from hurt: own isInvulnerableTo only adds IN_WALL and super, not blanket buried invulnerability.
complete_saved_three_additional_judgment.concrete_observation:
At most one complete multi-actor windup/quorum-to-victim-owned-committed timer family with damage-qualified unseating and divergent interruption semantics. Not Thrasher attempted-hit stun budget, Glider actual-HP accumulated grounding/target regrab lease, weight pickup lease, bubble release-source/dismount veto, TF global release gate, Betweenlands per-rider worldtick callback budget or Gammaroach attacker-mark cooldown spray. Registration, burial, sound cache, pose, random constant, two victim species and each goal/tick are support0, never separate credits. No universal damage immunity implementation is claimed.
独立复核后的限定：multi-actor仅指NPC pack而非真人双人；quorum只遍历链中PRAYING标志，不在该计数方法检查存活/实际站位，离开环位分支仅清worship而未清PRAYING，可能有陈旧标志。因此不是持续有效的几何/活体quorum。dismount/unseat指脱离乘骑，不能翻译成chunk unload。committed只指已武装未来runtime尝试，不是不可逆、持久、成功或恰一次转化。Gloomoth脱骑后仍倒计时，Vesper脱骑暂停但不清标志，之后任意乘骑可恢复。
complete_saved_three_additional_judgment.application_to_boss_immune: Authority must distinguish application admission, windup interruption, committed future effect and feedback lifetime. A damage-success dismount cue is not proof an armed effect was canceled; a chanted/visible state is not immunity denial. Boss feedback should follow exact authoritative reason and target, with explicit cleanup at each phase; do not add ordinary-constitution gray text or copy this ritual/gameplay.

Sound cache id equality is not UUID/dimension/session identity. The model/renderer were read as feedback consumers only, no specialist art design credit or modification. ACSoundRegistry individual entries/particle classes, engine transport and native transformation outcome not expanded. One failed local Python CA request followed by bounded normal system-curl fixed-commit acquisition; raw blob verified. No SSL verification disabling, account/model/provider bypass, retry loop or download-time credit.
Semantic search only selected nine actual prior decision records; broad initial output was truncated and was not counted as reading. All nine decision fields were then explicitly recovered in bounded outputs. No claim to have reread their old source chains.
Multi-actor means NPC pack members, not player multiplayer coordination.
Use dismount/unseat, not chunk unload. Armed/timer fields are local runtime fields; searched complete victim files show their declaration, tick and trigger writes only, with no explicit save/load or cancel reset. No unload/reload persistence or ticking while unloaded is claimed.
Committed means the trigger has armed a future runtime attempt; it does not mean irreversible, durable, guaranteed conversion or exactly-once settlement.

No live audio, pixel rendering, packet transport, native engine internals, cross-mod composition or gameplay acceptance was tested.
